title: Dislocated elbow: a benefit whose condition is evidence (X-ray or MRI), stated conditionally

turns.user: Mei landed badly on her elbow at gymnastics this afternoon and the clinic says it's dislocated. Is that something her PlayWell plan helps with?
turns.visible:
I’m sorry Mei hurt herself. Mei’s PlayWell plan lists a Dislocation benefit of an amount that is only shown after claim evidence has been reviewed per dislocation, payable once when diagnosed by a registered medical practitioner and confirmed by X-ray or MRI.
Was the dislocation confirmed by X-ray or MRI?

turns.user: Yes, the doctor at the clinic did an X-ray and it showed the dislocation.
turns.visible: Mei’s PlayWell plan lists a Dislocation benefit of S$600 per dislocation, payable once when diagnosed by a registered medical practitioner and confirmed by X-ray or MRI; you said the clinic doctor’s X-ray showed the dislocation.
